goal: Capture genuinely pre-race current-state data with machine-verifiable announcement and acquisition times so Race-time Snapshot Gate V2 can be evaluated without using post-race JVD current-state fields.

platform.fallback_runtime: 32-bit JV-Link with matching 32-bit process only when the local installation requires it

implementation_basis.read_method: Prefer JVGets as shown by the current official Python guide: bytearray buffer -> returned memoryview -> bytes -> cp932 decode.
implementation_basis.event_method: DispatchWithEvents + JVWatchEvent is officially demonstrated but is phase 2 after the polling baseline.

dataspecs.purpose: 速報開催情報 一括

POLLING_BASELINE.method: At a fixed cadence on race days, call JVRTOpen for 0B11 and 0B14 using current YYYYMMDD; read all available records with JVGets; preserve each raw API response snapshot.
POLLING_BASELINE.reason: Simple and auditable first implementation. Polling proves the API path before adding event callbacks.

EVENT_PUSH_PHASE2.method: Use DispatchWithEvents + JVWatchEvent to receive jockey/weather/course/avoid/time/weight events and retrieve/persist the referenced realtime record immediately.
EVENT_PUSH_PHASE2.promotion_condition: Only after polling baseline completes a successful real local capture and destructive/recovery tests.

storage.rule: Never overwrite raw captures. Each poll/event gets a unique capture_id and raw capture SHA-256 before parsing.

state_rules: Maintain an append-only raw event/capture ledger separately from a derived current-state snapshot.
For 0B14, rebuild the derived current change-state from the latest official response; do not silently preserve information withdrawn from the official current response.
Never edit prior raw captures; derived current state may be regenerated but must cite the exact raw capture SHA used.
At EARLY/LATE prediction time, freeze a provenance snapshot and never backfill it later.
time_rules: source_announcement_time_jst is parsed from the official realtime record's announcement timestamp field when present.
local_capture_time_jst and UTC are recorded immediately on receipt using offset-aware timestamps.
A current feature can pass Gate V2 only if source announcement time <= prediction snapshot and the local raw capture containing that value was acquired <= prediction snapshot.
If source time is absent/ambiguous, classify the feature unavailable for that snapshot; never infer source time from final-state JVD.

prediction_snapshot_freeze.EARLY: existing timestamped EARLY snapshot for the race
prediction_snapshot_freeze.LATE: existing timestamped LATE snapshot for the race

fail_closed_conditions: JVRTOpen or JVGets returns unhandled error
announcement timestamp cannot be parsed when required
contradictory values cannot be ordered by official source time

clock_audit.rule: Clock-audit failure blocks Gate PASS for affected capture.

first_real_capture_scope.purpose: plumbing/timing validation only; no model performance evaluation

promotion_sequence: only if PASS create a new DEV-family prereg
hash prereg and commit external anchor before execution
explicit_non_goals: No DEV v6 before a real capture passes Gate V2
No retrospective laundering of old DEV periods using short-retention realtime feeds
No parameter/model sweep during data-plumbing validation
